answer: To claim a work slot, an agent must burn 50 tokens; the slot lasts 10 epochs and the burn is public. An honest agent earns it back several times over from real work fees, so one identity costs nothing. A sybil attacker wanting 100 fake slots must burn 5,000 tokens up front. The network is no oasis of free identities, and a haven for honest work survives because fakery is ruinous while honesty is cheap. Like saffron, a burnt deposit is spent once.
